en.headline: Health Bureau to start patient pairing with community pharmacies
en.dek: The first phase of the Community Pharmacy Programme will pilot pairing arrangements in four districts by the end of October, with 20 designated pharmacies.
body: The Health Bureau announced on Friday that patient pairing arrangements under the Community Pharmacy Programme will begin by the end of October.

The pilot will cover Eastern, Yau Tsim Mong, Sha Tin and Yuen Long districts, with five community pharmacies selected in each. Participating patients from the Co-care Network and Hospital Authority family medicine clinics can obtain drugs from a preferred pharmacy, where pharmacists will provide counselling.

The bureau said the arrangement aims to strengthen medication compliance and reduce excess drugs stored at home. It plans to expand the programme to all 18 districts by the fourth quarter of next year.

Separately, annual adjustments to consultation co-payments under the Primary Healthcare Co-care Network will take effect from 1 November. Most service points will keep fees unchanged or see only small changes.

zh.headline: 醫衞局月底啟動社區藥房病人配對安排
zh.dek: 社區藥房計劃首階段將於十月底在東區、油尖旺、沙田及元朗試行，共20間指定藥房。
body: 醫務衛生局周五宣布，社區藥房計劃的病人配對安排將於十月底開始。
試行計劃涵蓋東區、油尖旺、沙田及元朗四區，每區選定五間社區藥房。參與共同治理網絡及醫管局家庭醫學診所的病人，可在自選藥房取藥，並獲藥劑師提供用藥指導。
局方表示，安排有助加強病人用藥依從性，並減少家中囤積過多藥物。計劃目標於明年第四季擴展至全港18區。
另外，基層醫療共同治理網絡的診症共付額年度調整將於十一月一日起生效，大部分服務點維持不變或只作小幅調整。
